lessons.keep: Show action logs next to the interface state that they change.
try: For a voice scheduling tool, keep the spoken-request transcript beside a confirmed reminder with a date and time.
Record the same settings navigation with the face inset below the controls and a tighter application crop.
lessons.avoid: Avoid using a Sent transcript entry as proof of a completed external task.
lessons.open: Was a reminder ultimately scheduled, and which provider controls can voice mode operate?
